ellie (partnerships): quick sync: CloudMarket accepted our joint workshop with NimbusCompute + BlueWave SI on 2026-08-04. Need speaker roster, demo running order, and swag/domestic vs. EU shipping plan by Fri EOD.

sam (marketing): nice! marketing prefers 4 panelists (3 speakers + moderator). we'll handle co-branded landing page + reminder email. what's the preferred demo cadence?

mike (product): suggest 10m context + 25m hands-on demo split into (A) Dedicated low-latency flow, (B) Private VPC onboarding via BlueWave SI. then 10m live Q&A. keep everything reproducible.

leah (solutions): i'll prepare a recorded fallback (in case live infra flaps) and a lightweight harness. warming script and health endpoint included. snippet for warmup: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'
```

ellie (partnerships): swag asks: Nimbus wants co-branded beanies x150; BlueWave wants 200 shirts + 300 stickers. who owns customs for EU deliveries?

sam (marketing): marketing will handle vendor selection and customs forms. need EPS logos + Pantone for Nimbus by Wed. also want promo code attached to Marketplace listing.

toby (nimbus): sending logo + rack photo today. Nimbus can ship to SF office by 2026-07-20. we also want the session recorded; Nimbus legal asks for a 10-business-day review before publishing.

mike (product): 10 business days is long for a gated replay. propose 3 business days for review; immediate publish of slides + audio, full video after review. ellie can you negotiate?

anya (bluewave-si): BlueWave is okay with 3 business days. for the demo we need a sample enterprise onboarding flow (SAML + private keys). leah can you add credential rotation steps to the runbook?

leah (solutions): will add rotate-demo-creds, KV cache restore, and a fallback to recorded demo in the runbook. also adding partner on-call numbers. repo: https://git.redwood.co/partnerships/cloudmarket-workshop (WIP). please don't merge until dry run passes.

ellie (partnerships): timeline: Wed - logos + speaker bios; Fri EOD - runbook + harness; Mon 07-27 - dry run with partners. who can take the dry run?

toby (nimbus): Nimbus can do Mon 07-27 afternoon PT.

anya (bluewave-si): BlueWave will join Mon morning PT and can rejoin afternoon if needed.

sam (marketing): i'll have landing page copy + email by Wed noon. need 1-line bios from speakers.

mike (product): speakers: mike (product overview), toby (Nimbus infra), anya (BlueWave SI flow), ellie (moderator). will DM bios to sam.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: landing-page-cloudmarket-nimbus-bluewave on 2026-07-05T18:00:00Z - status: pending.

ellie (partnerships): shipping note: Nimbus will ship to SF hub; marketing to confirm customs paperwork for EU shipments if we forward. sam, can you loop finance?

sam (marketing): looping finance now for HS codes and cross-border tax form.

ellie (partnerships): final: owners — runbook/leah, harness/leah, landing page/sam, logos/mike, partner comms/toby. action items due Fri EOD. ping here for blockers. :rocket:
